def_en: 1) as far as, even to, until, up to, while, as far as
1a1) as far as, up to, even to
1c1) even to, until, unto, till, during, end
1d1) even to, to the degree of, even like
2) until, while, to the point that, so that even
kjv: against, and, as, at, before, by (that), even (to), for(-asmuch as), (hither-) to, [phrase] how long, into, as long (much) as, (so) that, till, toward, until, when, while, ([phrase] as) yet.
expl: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
etim: properly, the same as (used as a preposition, adverb or conjunction; especially with a preposition);
